prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. One complete existing DooKnow LOCAL component on neutral light-gray backdrop, not a full invented host page. Simplified Chinese, crisp natural-size controls, flat white/#f7f8fa, dark #272b3a/secondary#657084, thin #e6e9f1 lines, primary#4566c6,8px radii and restrained shadow. PILOT input is STYLE ONLY, no importing its rail/header/tree/content. Actual source templates determine all titles, field order, controls, permissions and selected state. No protocol requestId/version/hash/cursor/CSRF fields, fabricated success/online states, team/AI/ToDoo features or OS/browser-dialog chrome. Secret data empty or masked only. One coherent selected condition; hidden alternatives remain hidden. Preserve header/close/body-scroll/footer actions and actual disabled guards; do not derive new disabled rules from API constraints.
EXACT OWNER SHARE FORM PRIVATE CREATION STATE from matching Image1 (Image2 PILOT style only), draw only modal not background workspace. Title 分享笔记 and closeX. Body note title 窗口运行基线 with badge 私人笔记. Exact note 笔记默认私有。生成链接后，持有链接的访客无需登录即可访问。 Fields source desktop2columns: 分享权限 closed select仅查看, 链接有效期 closed select7 天. Next full-width unchecked checkbox 允许下载图形原件, helper 原件可能包含预览未展示的编辑内容，默认关闭。 Existing flat info block refreshicon, bold实时更新, body 展示最新保存内容，未保存的修改不会公开。 Footer primary生成分享链接 and default完成, enabled.
Source conditions status.state=private/status.enabled=false, permission=view, editSupported=true, duration7d, allowDiagramSource=false,busy=false/noerror. Thus公开链接/copy/reset/revoke/custom-date/edit-limitation text stay HIDDEN; don't add them just because generic all-state inventory lists them. No password/login/team/recipient/email/CSRF/hash inputs. No URL token displayed or fake share-created status. NModal does not explicitly lock default X/Escape/backdrop while busy; do not invent a different busy-close rule, selected state idle. Preserve source permissions and saved-content/publication boundary.
